steps.text: Run a live Postgres write burst via holo backup:wal --json — WAL archives to R2 continuously, zero continuity gaps (status=success, continuityOk, R2 growth, writeBurstRows≥1).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:wal --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json; jq -e '.status=="success" and .ok==true and .continuityOk==true and .r2WalObjectCountAfter > .r2WalObjectCountBefore and .writeBurstRows >= 1 and .heartbeat.status=="success" and (.heartbeat.last_success_at != null)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json >/dev/null; ! jq -e '.status=="failed" or .ok==false or .continuityOk==false or .writeBurstRows < 1 or (.r2WalObjectCountAfter <= .r2WalObjectCountBefore)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:status > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt || true; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; grep -qE 'wal_archive:.*(OK|status=success)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; ! grep -qE 'wal_archive:.*(FAILED|OVERDUE)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt

steps.text: Run the scheduled base-backup job — full backup lands in the R2 bucket, verified by manifest.
Run the restic blob-mirror job — every local/remote object SHA-256 matches.
Kill the backup job mid-archive — alert fires within 15 minutes, no dashboard-polling needed.
steps.literal_cmd: bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode kill --job wal_archive && bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep

steps.text: Let the bucket credential expire in a test fixture — alert fires, not a silent failure.
steps.literal_cmd: bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode credential-expired --job base_backup && bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep

steps.text: Remove the backup config entirely — the alert still fires as overdue, never a false-healthy state.
steps.literal_cmd: bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode config-removed --job restic_blob_mirror && bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep
